_why: Test-flake root cause 2026-10-05: a session fixture unlinked every /tmp/audit_*_run* file that appeared during the session, and /tmp is shared by every pytest session on the machine, other worktrees included, so one session deleted a concurrent session's live stems (`sed: /tmp/audit_handed-..._p2.asm.txt: No such file or directory`, random audit-cycle failures, BASELINE_NOT_GREEN under concurrent mutation runs). audit-cycle now stages under $HMAD_AUDIT_STEM_DIR (default /tmp, validated absolute, existing, colon-free), the conftest points it at the session's basetemp, and nothing sweeps /tmp. Each row breaks one of those properties.

mutations.name: stem-dir-ignores-the-variable
mutations._mechanism: The verb never reads HMAD_AUDIT_STEM_DIR, so every test session stages in the shared /tmp again.

mutations.name: stem-dir-default-moves
mutations._mechanism: Production callers set nothing; a changed default moves every live audit's staged files away from /tmp, where the recipes and humans look.

mutations.name: stem-ignores-the-dir
mutations._mechanism: The directory is validated but the stem is still minted under /tmp.

mutations.name: stem-dir-relative-accepted
mutations._mechanism: A relative directory resolves against the verb's cwd, and the assembler refuses the relative report path as an assemble HALT instead of a usage error.

mutations.name: stem-dir-colon-accepted
mutations._mechanism: A ':' in the directory splits the --pass i:<report>:<out>:<rc>:<log> payload at the wrong place.

mutations.name: stem-dir-missing-accepted
mutations._mechanism: A missing directory fails later at the first redirect, as exit 4, after the verb has started work.

mutations.name: session-exports-no-stem-dir
mutations._mechanism: The session never points the verb at its basetemp, so its stems land in the shared /tmp.

mutations.name: session-sweeps-what-appeared-in-tmp
mutations._mechanism: The removed defect: a session-end set-difference sweep of /tmp deletes a concurrent session's stem. Narrowed to the names the RED test stages so the mutant run cannot touch a real session's files.

mutations.name: divergence-filter-reads-paths-as-regex
mutations._mechanism: Review should-fix: report paths reached `grep -v -e` as basic regexes; a stem dir holding `[` made grep error, the filter printed nothing, foreign counted 0 and the prompt_divergence HALT could never fire.
